title: glandularia microphylla
intro: Glandularia microphylla, commonly known as Rosy Verbena, is a species of flowering plant in the family Verbenaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Glandularia microphylla include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Glandularia microphylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
